product_metadata.title: Z-DESDEMONA Oil Sprayer for Cooking, Olive Oil Sprayer Mister, Olive Oil Spray Bottle, kitchen Gadgets Accessories for Air Fryer,Canola Oil Spritzer, Widely used for Baking Frying
features: 🍰【2022 All-in-One Oil Sprayer】Z-DESDEMONA Oil Sprayer is a perfect accessory for kitchen and family. Suitable for all kinds of liquids and oils, olive oil, avocado oil, vegetable oil, vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, fruit juice. In addition, it can also be widely used in air fryer, frying steak, barbecue, salad, baking, frying. Better control and simplify your cooking process. Also suitable for spraying alcohol and water to clean kitchen and furniture, also can be used to water plants.

🍰【Precise Control Of Multi-angle Oil Absorption】Upgraded removable nozzle, 360° rotation mode allows you to get 100% uniform atomization from multiple angles (including horizontal or vertical), keeping the nozzle clean and no oil dripping from the nozzle. Control the pressure to change the spray pattern. A quick press will produce a fog or fan effect, and a half press will produce a columnar effect. Large-area keys for easy pressing and dose control. The bottom has a non-slip design.

🍰【Food-grade Safety Glass Material】We use safer, thicker, scratch-resistant glass material as the container bottle for the fuel injector, which is resistant to high and low temperatures, has no peculiar smell, and is not easily broken or damaged. Press quickly to spray a fan-shaped mist, which consumes less fuel and evenly sprays every part of the food. Precise oil control, reduce oil intake and control calories while enjoying delicious food.

🍰【Sealed Leak-proof & Large Diameter Design】Multi-layer screw interface design, excellent sealing performance ensures no oil leakage. The cover is easier to open and close, easy to clean. The large-caliber bottle mouth can easily add edible oil, which can be used efficiently and without waste. The spray bottle is sturdy and lightweight for one-handed use and easy to carry anywhere you want. Transparent bottle design, easy to distinguish the remaining liquid amount.

🍰【Easy To Use, Clean And Care】The glass body is dishwasher safe. An unobstructed hose will not cause oil to clog. It is recommended that you keep the sprayer angle greater than or equal to 45 degrees when using the oil for a better even mist, and the liquid is preferably more than halfway up the bottle.
